title: vcw-heavyweight
label: "Mad" Jack McMad
note: Still champion as of the promotion's own broadcast of 26 March 1999.

title: vcw-heavyweight
label: Tommy Travis

won.source: The promotion's own billing entering New Year's Revolution, which frames Travis as reigning champion for several months.

note: Lost the title to Jack McMad on a fast three-count made by the promotion's own interim commissioner while the assigned referee was still down.

title: vcw-cruiserweight
label: "The Philosopher" Frederick Russell

won.source: The promotion's own billing entering New Year's Revolution.

note: Retained against Bobby Durango at New Year's Revolution; commentary also credits Russell with regaining the title from a masked challenger, Hurricane, earlier the same night he first lost it, an event not otherwise dated in this record.

title: vcw-heavyweight-tag-team
label: Creature Feature
note: Billed on the broadcast as the team's third reign; the two earlier reigns implied by that count are not otherwise dated in this record. Still champions as of the promotion's own broadcast of 26 March 1999, with the Gods of War and the Wyld Stallions both seeking the next title shot.

title: vcw-heavyweight-tag-team
label: Gods of War

won.source: The promotion's own billing entering New Year's Revolution.

note: Lost the title at New Year's Revolution to a mystery challenger revealed mid-match as Creature Feature, who never appeared under their own names.

title: vcw-western-states
label: Sir Valiant
note: Won the title on his third attempt at it, after reaching the finals of the first Western States tournament and the semifinals of a later one.

title: vcw-western-states
label: Chris West

won.source: The promotion's own billing entering New Year's Revolution.

note: Lost the title to Sir Valiant, who had come up short in two prior tournament attempts at it.

title: vcw-ironman
label: "American Made" Jeff Ladd

won.source: The promotion's own billing, which frames Ladd's VCW Pro title defense as his first since "a grueling" title win.

note: A challenge from Billy the Kid at VCW Pro (26 March 1999) was thrown out for interference by other wrestlers; the promotion's interim commissioner rebooked the two in a steel-cage, loser-leaves-VCW match for a later pay-per-view not otherwise present in this record.

title: vcw-womens
label: Amanda Reese

won.source: The promotion's own billing, which credits Reese as undefeated through eight matches.

note: A scheduled unification defense against a champion from outside the promotion did not take place: the promotion's own broadcast reports the challenger withdrew and was reconsidering her career.
